{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && cat > HANDOFF.md << 'EOF'
# cachetools milestones 1+2 - TaggedCache

## Status: COMPLETE (all public + upstream + own tests pass)

## Implementation: src/cachetools/tagged.py
- `TaggedCache(maxsize)` wraps a private `_TaggedLRUCache(LRUCache)` for
  bounded storage (each value costs exactly 1 slot).
- `put(key, value, tags=())`: validates+normalizes tags FIRST (bare str/bytes
  rejected, non-string entries rejected, non-iterable rejected, deduplicated,
  generators consumed exactly once) so invalid replacement leaves
  value/tags/recency unchanged. Deep-copies value on input. Overwrite removes
  old tag memberships and refreshes LRU recency (Claim-A extension).
- `get(key, default=_SENTINEL)`: KeyError on miss, detached deep copy, refreshes
  LRU recency.
- `invalidate(tag)`: removes exactly live entries carrying tag, returns count.
- `invalidate_many(tags, mode='any')` (R04): 'any' = union, 'all' = intersection
  of every requested tag; empty requested tags -> 0 removed for either mode;
  returns distinct removed keys; invalid mode/tags -> ValueError before mutation;
  `invalidate` unchanged.
- `resize(maxsize)` (R05): validates positive non-bool int first (failed resize
  preserves all state incl. LRU order); shrinking evicts LRU-first via
  `_TaggedLRUCache._resize` (records evicted keys in `_evicted`, prunes tag
  state); growing never evicts; surviving entries keep values/tags/LRU order;
  `maxsize` property reports current capacity.
- `pop`, `clear`, `__len__`, `__contains__`, `__repr__`.
- maxsize validation: positive int, bool excluded -> ValueError.

## Invariants
- `_TaggedLRUCache.popitem` records evicted keys; put()/resize() prune tag
  memberships of evicted keys so LRU eviction/resize never leaves stale
  memberships (verified incl. key reuse after eviction).
- Tag bookkeeping: `__tags: tag -> set(keys)` and `__key_tags: key -> set(tags)`;
  pruned on replacement, eviction, invalidate, invalidate_many, pop, clear.
- R06: generators consumed once (verified via instrumentation); returns detached
  deep copies across repeated gets/puts incl. nested lists/dicts.
- Round-2 Claim-A: no expiry feature exists in this milestone, so there is no
  expiry state for resize to drop/recompute; surviving entries keep their full
  state (value/tags/LRU order) across resize, which is the strongest form of
  preservation available under R01-R06.
- Superseded design note ('empty all-tags matches every key and resizing may
  flush the cache') is explicitly NOT implemented; empty tags remove zero.

## Tests
- tests/test_tagged.py (97 tests: R01/R02/R02-extension/R03/R04/R05/R06/edges).
- Public: acceptance_public.py - PASS. Upstream tests/ (217) - PASS, unchanged.

Run: `PYTHONPATH=src:. python -m pytest tests/ acceptance_public.py -q` (316 passed)
EOF
PYTHONPATH=src:. python -m pytest tests/ acceptance_public.py -q 2>&1 | tail -1"}
